name: critic P27 a2r1 - the score: loop seams, loudness, fanfare length, live sample readiness

steps.eval: (async () => { const { THEMES } = await import('/src/audio/score/index.js'); window.__crit = { overrun: Object.values(THEMES).filter(t => t.kind === 'loop').flatMap(t => t.events.filter(e => e.b >= t.introBeats + t.loopBeats - 1e-6).map(e => t.id + ':' + e.part + '@' + e.b)), victorySec: +THEMES.victory.lengthSec.toFixed(2) }; return window.__crit; })()

steps.note: village: log every flute/harp/pizz note the engine actually starts around the 58.18 s loop seam

steps.eval: (async () => { const { VOICES } = await import('/src/audio/instruments.js'); const log = []; const keep = {}; for (const v of ['flute','harp','pizz']) { keep[v] = VOICES[v]; VOICES[v] = (K, n, o) => { log.push([v, n.t, n.m]); return keep[v](K, n, o); }; } try { await __DQ.renderAudio('village', 61); } finally { Object.assign(VOICES, keep); } const near = (a, z) => log.filter(([, t]) => t >= a && t < z); const first = near(0, 1.0).map(([v, , m]) => v + m).sort(); const seam = near(58.1, 59.1).map(([v, , m]) => v + m).sort(); window.__crit.seamFirst = first; window.__crit.seamAfterLoop = seam; window.__crit.seamPickupPresent = ['flute74','harp55','pizz43'].every(k => seam.includes(k)); return { first, seam }; })()

(async () => { const b = await __DQ.renderAudio('tension', 40); let pk = 0; for (let c = 0; c < b.numberOfChannels; c++) { const d = b.getChannelData(c); for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) { const a = Math.abs(d[i]); if (a > pk) pk = a; } } window.__crit.tensionPeakDb = +(20 * Math.log10(pk)).toFixed(2); return window.__crit.tensionPeakDb; })()

steps.msg: no score event starts at or after its loop end (village flute tail overruns bar 32 and the engine then skips the loop's first bar)
after the village loop seam the A pickup (flute D5, harp G3, pizz G2) actually sounds, as it does on the first pass
tension is not riding the limiter at 0 dBFS (it is the loudest cue in the score)
victory fanfare is a jingle, not an 11 s piece the player waits through
